items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
The Cavaliers clear about $6.8M by trading Dennis Schroder for Tre Mann.

Cleveland will be approximately $29.6M under the first apron after this trade with Charlotte.

Hornets take on $6.8M in this trade and will be just shy of $20M under the luxury tax line.
